description: Prior approval for change of use of carpet shop to restaurants and cafes with installation of air extraction system
decision_conditions: Condition : 1 - The development hereby permitted shall be completed before the expiration of three years from the date of this permission.

Condition : 2 - The proposed development shall be carried out in all respects in accordance with the proposals contained in the application and the plans submitted (2020(AR)78-01, 2020(AR)78-02, 2020(AR)78-03, 2020(AR)78-04 received 15 January 2021) therewith and approved by the Local Planning Authority, or as shall have been otherwise agreed in writing by the Local Planning Authority before the building is used.
Condition : 3 - The external finish of the  extraction flue shall be black

Condition : 4 - Mechanical Services Noise Control 
a) The cumulative measured or calculated noise emitted from the plant hereby approved shall be 10dB(A) below the existing background noise level, at all times whilst the plant is in operation.
b) The plant shall be isolated on adequate proprietary anti-vibration mounts to prevent the structural transmission of vibration and regenerated noise within adjacent or adjoining premises, and these shall be so maintained thereafter unless agreed otherwise in writing by the Local Planning Authority.
c) Following installation of any mechanical services plant including heating, ventilation and air conditioning (HVAC) to which the application refers, a post completion noise assessment shall be submitted for approval to the local planning authority which demonstrates the actual measured rating level of plant operating under normal conditions. All measurements shall be made in accordance with the methodology of BS4142: 2014 (Methods for rating and assessing industrial and commercial sound) and/or its subsequent amendments. 
The post completion report shall be both completed and submitted to the local authority within 28 days of completion of the installation for review.

Condition : 5 - Delivery and collection times (including refuse) for commercial premises, which are situated in or very near to residential areas are only carried out between the following hours: Monday to Saturday between 07:00 and 22:00, Sunday between 09:00 to 20:00.

Condition : 6 - The use hereby permitted for A3 purposes shall not be open to customers outside the following times: 10:00 - 23:00 on Monday to Friday, 10:00 - 23:30 on Saturday and 10:00 to 22:30 on Sundays and Bank Holidays.

Condition : 7 - The use hereby approved shall not commence until a secure storage area within the site enclosed by a two metre high close boarded fence or within one of the outbuildings to house not less than two 1100 litre galvanised steel Eurobins has been identified and made available, together with facilities for the separation and safe storage of glass, metal, plastics, cardboard, food waste and other recyclable materials which shall then be collected and taken to a suitable facility for recycling.  The storage area and bins shall be made permanently available before the development is first occupied and no waste shall be stored outside the site or other than in the designated area.  The lids of the Eurobins shall be fixed shut at all times other than when waste is being emptied into them.  Non-recyclable and perishable waste shall be removed from site no less frequently than once a week.  Waste shall be removed from the site to a suitable enclosed private storage area or an authorised refuse disposal or recycling site as soon as the bins become full if this is earlier than the time of the normal collection, unless additional covered and enclosed bins (as described above) have been provided and are thereafter made permanently available for the on-site storage of refuse and waste.
